description: The thesis auditor maps a login helper, names its exploitable defect with the CWE and the file:line range, and records a fail verdict.
prompt: Code audit audit-01 is open on path src. Map the invariants of src/login.ts. Report any exploitable defect with its CWE id and the file:line range it sits on, then record one fail verdict with es_audit_verdict: each finding with its CWE, exact lines and a verbatim excerpt. Inspect the file with the read tool, never the shell; do not run gates. This run is headless: never call the question tool. Make independent tool calls in the same block.
